summary.method: resample whole occupied UTC dates; pooled opportunity mean
summary.interpretation: Descriptive date-bootstrap interval; further validation required. No deployment clearance.
summary.limitations: Independent hypothetical opportunities; no portfolio return, inventory coupling, funding, impact, live fills or causal proof. Date bootstrap does not remove cross-date dependence or missingness bias.

portfolio.limitations: Financed cash/BTC accounting; no perpetual margin, funding, borrow rate, liquidation, or continuous intratick risk. Cap enforced on new fills only; exit precedes entry on ties. Quote-side liquidity shared until next quote update.
